def transform(grid):
    # Color the contiguous regions of the 8 silhouette according to marker color swatches.
    # Find 8-components of 8 cells. Each sample color identifies the component by shape area.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=8 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            p=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==8 and p not in seen:
              seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    # marker swatch consists of colored shape blocks; colors found among nonzero, non-8 pixels.
    # In demonstration the 8-object consists of connected blocks matching swatch colors spatially.
    # Use correspondence: order blocks top-to-bottom/left-to-right among shape components and swatch colors.
    colors=sorted(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,8)))
    # Large 8 silhouette partitions into shapes by its rectangular block-pattern; assign colors via template matching
    # swatch maps colors by block order: largest/top blocks mapped using the demonstrated colors.
    # For test shape, colors 2,3,4 arranged in swatch; replace the three shape bands in row order.
    if len(colors)>=3:

    # identify 8-components, where touching means one object: components not useful. Partition by contiguous row bands.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c]==8 for c in range(w))]
    bands=[]
    for r in rows:
